RBI Rate Hike December 2026: Will your Home Loan EMI become more expensive as inflation crosses the RBI's upper limit, even while India's stock market is booming?
India's October 2026 inflation numbers have raised serious concerns. Consumer Price Index (CPI) inflation has reached 6.09%, crossing the RBI's 6% upper tolerance limit, while Wholesale Price Index (WPI) inflation has surged to 12.29%. From vegetables and food prices to fuel, electricity, transport, restaurants and manufacturing costs, inflationary pressure is spreading across the economy.
